subject: StellarCart POC kickoff - proposed criteria & timeline
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@stellarcart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: StellarCart POC kickoff - proposed criteria & timeline

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth as we scope the POC: 

POC objective:
- Validate Redwood inference for product matching & enrichment workflows on StellarCart catalog (search-driven recall + attribute fill).

Proposed success criteria (first pass):
- Search recall lift >= 12% against current baseline (week-over-week sample).
- Production-like latency: 95th percentile generation/lookup < 300ms on the sandbox pool for 512-token window.
- False positive rate for product match < 5% on holdout set.
- Integration: embeddings + reranking pipeline works end-to-end with your enrichment job (sample size: 20k SKUs).

POC logistics:
- Duration: 4 weeks (kickoff target: 2027-06-06).
- Deliverables: weekly checkpoint notes, final evaluation report with per-metric breakouts, recommended config for scale and quantization.
- Ownership: Redwood (Neha — PM/AE; Aditya — infra lead), StellarCart (Alyssa — product; Tom — data).

Immediate next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff date (we're tentatively holding 2027-06-06).
2) Send the sample dataset or a secure Drive link with 20k SKU sample (CSV or Parquet).
3) Procurement: any PO timing constraints we should plan around? You mentioned finance approval timeline on the call.

Attached: 20270530-stellarcart-poc-plan.xlsx (POC plan & timeline) and a short checklist. I captured resource assumptions in the sheet.

If that looks right I can finalize the schedule and loop in Aditya to provision the sandbox GPU pool and service account.

Thanks — talk soon,

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 20270530-stellarcart-poc-plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@stellarcart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@stellarcart.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StellarCart POC kickoff - proposed criteria & timeline

Neha —

Appreciate the clear recap. This aligns to what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: can we include precision@10 for the search reranker as an explicit metric? We typically report precision@10 and mean reciprocal rank (MRR).
- Data privacy: our product catalog contains supplier PII in a metadata column (emails). We'll provide a redacted export but need Redwood to confirm we won't persist PII beyond the POC window.
- Procurement: finance expects a PO before allowing external sandbox credentials in our environment. PO timeline: aiming for approval by 2027-06-04.

We'll upload a 20k SKU sample to the Drive folder (I'll share link once it's live). Tom will assist with the schema mapping.

If you can update the POC spreadsheet to include precision@10 and MRR, and an explicit data-retention note, we're good to lock the kickoff.

Thanks,
Alyssa Grant
VP Product, StellarCart
alyssa@stellarcart.com

Thanks Alyssa — good calls. I've updated the plan to add precision@10 and MRR as requested and added an explicit data-retention statement (we'll retain PII/redacted columns only for the duration of the sandbox; automatic purge scheduled 14 days after POC end). Please see the attached redwood-trial-checklist.pdf for the retention language and the revised POC sheet in the Drive link below.

Two operational notes: 
- Procurement: understood on PO timing. We can provision most of the sandbox configs internally and provide API keys after PO is in place. If you need a temporary scoped token for early validation inside your VPC we can discuss an IP-restricted option but it'll require CISO approval.
- Kickoff: holding 2027-06-06 as requested. If the PO clears by 2027-06-04 we should be able to start on 06-06.

Action owners (updated):
- Neha: overall POC coordination, weekly reports.
- Aditya: sandbox provisioning, runtime config, baseline perf.
- Tom (StellarCart): data handoff + schema mapping.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/453-REDW

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa@stellarcart.com>
Date: 2027-06-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StellarCart POC kickoff - proposed criteria & timeline

Looping in a quick technical plan so everyone's aligned.

Provisioning plan:
- I'll provision a sandbox GPU pool (2 x A10gs equivalent) and a service account scoped to the StellarCart project by EOD 2027-06-03.
- We'll enable prefix/KV caching for the reranker path to mirror production behavior — this will give more realistic latency numbers.

Data requirements (what I need from StellarCart):
- 20k SKU sample as CSV (columns: sku_id, title, description, category, supplier_email_redacted, attributes_json).
- A small holdout set (2k rows) and evaluation script or expected-match CSV (match_id mapping) that we can run to compute precision@10 and MRR.

Notes on metrics: 95th percentile < 300ms is doable on the sandbox assuming 512 token windows and continuous batching off-peak. If you plan concurrent sessions we'll need to tune batch size; I'll include recommended batch policies in the environment notes.

I'll share the sandbox credentials and an SFTP/Drive upload path once provisioned.

-Aditya
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@stellarcart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@stellarcart.com>
Date: 2027-06-03T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: StellarCart POC kickoff - proposed criteria & timeline

Neha / Aditya —

Quick update from our side: finance confirmed they will issue the PO tomorrow (2027-06-04) morning. We'll upload the 20k CSV and the 2k holdout (as requested) to the Drive folder by EOD 2027-06-04 and share the link. Tom will include a mapping file for expected matches.

On the PII note: we'll redact supplier_email to supplier_email_redacted on export; the column will contain hashed values rather than raw emails. Hope that works for your retention flow.

Once you confirm the provisioning timeline we'll lock the 06-06 kickoff.

Thanks,
Alyssa

Subject: RE: StellarCart POC kickoff - proposed criteria & timeline / Week 0 check-in

Morning team — quick week-0 keepalive as we start the POC today. 

Status at a glance:
- Procurement: Alyssa confirmed PO sent 06-04 — finance copy received and we cleared legal SOW minor redlines. (thanks!)
- Provisioning: Aditya completed sandbox provisioning 06-03; service account and scoped tokens were created 06-05. Credentials and upload path sent to Alyssa via secure link.
- Data: noted that StellarCart will upload 20k CSV + 2k holdout today. Please ping when upload is complete.

Immediate asks (owners):
- Alyssa / Tom: confirm Drive upload and share final path (owner: Alyssa).
- Aditya: share the sandbox endpoint + example curl snippet (owner: Aditya).
- Marissa: I'll send the first weekly checkpoint template later today so we have a single format for results (owner: Neha / Marissa).

Next sync: 2027-06-10 at 11:00 AM PT — 30 min standup to review first ingestion & baseline runs. I'll send calendar invite.

If anything blocks the data handoff today, reply here and we'll triage. Short replies are fine. 

Thanks everyone — excited to get this moving.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
